statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T≤X → H≤X → (X:ℝ)^((7:ℝ)/120+ε) ≤ (H:ℝ) → (((Finset.Icc (X-H) X).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.Prime (q+6) ∧ p+q=n)).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(H:ℝ)/(1+Real.log (X:ℝ))^A

plain_statement.zh: 让 n 和 n+6 的两个表示共享一个素数，在每个短区间控制失败数。
plain_statement.en: Find a shared prime summand for n and n+6 throughout almost all of each short interval.

brief.zh: 两次独立应用短区间定理得不到同一素数。需要素数对 q、q+6 的下界，属于高度探索性的固定差难题。
brief.en: Separate representations need not intersect. A lower bound for prime pairs at gap six is a substantial additional obstacle.
